limitations: AST matches are candidates. They do not prove that old and new model semantics, units, calendar, adjustment, PIT, or entitlement match.
The legacy sink is separately recorded. Even READY_FOR_ADAPTER does not map a writer, dataset key, warehouse table, publication, or ownership epoch.
The iteration-203 task counts are historical document evidence only. No database or installed systemd/crontab state was queried.
The crosswalk covers the 1,066-script source tree plus repository-contained ops/config/runtime references; untracked host-local jobs are outside this scan.
OpenData provider functions are extracted from local registry descriptors and model AST. They remain runtime-unverified.
Credential values are never emitted; source arguments retain only parameter names, source line, and expression kind.

status_definitions.MISSING_PROVIDER: The source function is declared in the local vendored export catalog, but no registered OpenData Fetcher was statically matched.
status_definitions.READY_FOR_ADAPTER: Static endpoint and parameter-name compatibility candidate only; runtime and dataset migration remain unverified.

verification_notice: READY_FOR_ADAPTER means only that static endpoint and parameter names appear compatible for that endpoint. It does not mean a script, task, dataset, source, permission, history, quality rule, sink, or production run has migrated or passed runtime verification.
